scope: the failed symbol when fetch returns None or an empty frame; a raised fetch aborts the rest of that cycle because evaluate re-raises into run_bot
software_profit_protection: not reached for the failed symbol
emergency_or_weekend_flatten: not reached for the failed symbol, including when a position exists and the weekend flag is set
broker_native_stops: unchanged at the broker; broker_sl_tp_hit stays false and no cancel is sent
fresh_manage_quote_when_candles_exist: monitoring runs and does not close merely because the quote is fresh
stale_manage_quote_when_candles_exist: software stop and profit protection do not fire; weekend flatten can still request a close because the trigger is the clock
repeated_failures: each later cycle tries candles again and skips management until a frame arrives
proposed_repair: On a missing, empty, or failed candle fetch, run the existing-position management block from the pricing snapshot and do not open a new entry. Keep a stale broker quote from authorising a software stop or profit-protection close. Do not invent candles. Catch a fetch exception per symbol so later symbols are still managed. This is a trading-behaviour change and was not applied.
